# Coding 0.6.0

This is the first public release of Coding, a desktop coding agent built on the
`or` Go packages.

## Coding

- Native macOS application for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- Persistent, workspace-based conversations with streaming responses, queued
  messages, follow-ups, usage details, and automatic context compaction.
- Built-in file, search, shell, browser, and workbench tools with permission
  modes and explicit approvals.
- Provider and model settings, connection tests, thinking controls, skills,
  attachments, background tasks, and interactive questions.

## Go packages

- `harness` is now a top-level package at `github.com/ktsoator/or/harness`.
- Agent events now distinguish tool progress from final tool results.
- LLM provider metadata and thinking controls have been updated across the model
  catalog.

## Downloads and current limitations

DMG and ZIP builds are available for Apple Silicon (`arm64`) and Intel (`x64`)
Macs running macOS 12 or later. Windows and Linux builds are not included.

The macOS builds are not signed or notarized. macOS may require confirmation
before the first launch.

The embedded browser should currently be used only with content you trust.
Dedicated isolation for untrusted pages is not complete.
